maya: Quick docs PR question — the webhook callback example in the API reference currently shows the root payload as an array of event objects, but the service actually returns an object with an `events` field (we switched shapes in PR #4623). Can someone confirm which shape we want in the canonical example?

maya: Current example in docs (incorrect):
```json
[
  { "type": "message.created", "id": "evt_123", "data": { ... } },
  { "type": "message.updated", "id": "evt_124", "data": { ... } }
]
```

maya: Runtime returns this (preferred):
```json
{
  "events": [
    { "type": "message.created", "id": "evt_123", "data": { ... } },
    { "type": "message.updated", "id": "evt_124", "data": { ... } }
  ],
  "delivery_id": "del_789"
}
```

maya: Also the Node/Python SDK snippets in the same page call the callback param `webhook_url` but the OpenAPI and runtime use `callback_url`. We should standardize to `callback_url` across examples and call out the param rename in the migration note. @ben can you take the examples?

ben: Yep — thanks for catching. I accidentally reverted the object-wrapper change during a sample cleanup. Standardize to `callback_url` and object top-level with `events`. I'll open a small docs PR to fix both the JSON example and the SDK snippets.

akshay: Small nits to hit while you're at it: update the cURL examples to include the required header `Content-Type: application/json`, and for the SSE streaming callback sample add `curl -N` (or `--no-buffer`) so people testing locally don't get buffered output. Also the JS fetch example needs `response.ok` check for non-2xx.

maya: Sweet — can you also add a short note in the API reference "Note for migrating from v0.9" explaining the array->object change and the param rename? That would save customer confusion.

ben: On it. I'll open PR and tag reviewers. Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4888 — includes: fix JSON example, update curl/node/python snippets, add migration blurb. Commit: 7a1b2c3.

jen: Quick reminder — update the OpenAPI example block under `/webhooks/subscribe` too, not just the prose. We had a different example there.

ben: Good call, will update both places and add a unit test that renders examples from the OpenAPI YAML so this doesn't diverge again.

docs-bot: PR 4888 created by ben — label: docs, needs review from @maya @jen. CI: docs-build pending.

maya: Thanks all. If CI passes I'll merge and then follow up with a short note in the migration guide and changelog.

ben: ETA ~30m for PR update, ping me if anything else pops up. :thumbsup:
